To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Google AdSense is vulnerable to an attack which allows the automatic retrieval of the links of the published advertisements.

the Google AdSense advertising system is vulnerable to a cross-site scripting attack that allows the automatic extraction of links to the ads published on any website that uses the Google AdSense system for advertising.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the automatic extraction of the links of the Google AdSense ads published in a website, by means of the XSS and the Web Crawler techniques, and the use of the user sessions to load such links through a re-direction to the Google server.
the possibility of obtaining the links of the Google ads and the possibility of using the same links, through a re-direction, to load the ads in the background.
the automatic extraction of the ads links, the use of such links in other websites and the automatic redirection to the ads.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
it is possible to obtain the links of the Google Ads and to load such links in other websites through a simple redirection, without having to go through the usual barriers of Google Adsense.
Google Adsense is not as secure as we might think.
the system of Google Adsense does not provide a safe and reliable way of publishing ads on websites.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

it is possible to obtain the validated links of ads from the Google AdSense advertising system, by exploiting the vulnerability of the Google AdSense system and by using the XSS and Web Crawler technologies, in order to obtain such links, and to use such links to click the ads of a website, by exploiting the sessions of users visiting other websites, so that the clicks are performed by the IP addresses of the users visiting other websites.
it is possible to obtain the validated links to Google ads, which are normally not accessible to the public, through the exploitation of a vulnerability in the AdSense advertising system.
the Google Adsense system is not able to prevent the automatic extraction of links of ads.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Google Adsense system is vulnerable to a XSS attack and it is possible to automatically extract the links to ads.
it is possible to obtain validated links to ads published on the Internet, which are then used to load such ads in other websites, without the user’s knowledge.
it is possible to obtain the validated link to an ad, which is not available through the Google AdSense API.
